en-US.name: Sahayak Study Assistant
en-US.shortDescription: Quiz yourself on any topic, review flashcards, and plan your study time.
en-US.fullDescription: Sahayak Study is your voice-first AI study companion. Generate grounded multi-choice quizzes on any topic from science to history, practice spaced repetition flashcards using the SM-2 algorithm, build structured daily exam study schedules, track your learning streaks and weak areas, and get concise Wikipedia-grounded topic briefs—completely hands-free.
examplePhrases: Make a study plan for my chemistry exam on the 15th.
How am I doing in my quizzes?
Give me a quick brief on the French Revolution.
Quiz me on my weak topics.
